findings.evidence: engine.make_model passes n_task_layers=4 to the exact pinned SeHGNN. Its IMDB task MLP constructs three nn.BatchNorm1d(hidden, affine=False) without overriding the default track_running_stats=True. They register running_mean, running_var and num_batches_tracked. Session._initialize rejects any named_buffers, and forward repeats the rejection.
findings.impact: All ten declared conditions fail construction with the exact bound native architecture before any P/S update. The ROOT_CLARIFICATIONS stateless premise is inconsistent with the bound source. Deleting or disabling native BN would change the required architecture and semantics.
findings.required_action: Use a separately versioned source and explicit native member-private BN buffer policy covering same-state reference/replay, accepted buffer advancement, stopped terminal peers, selection snapshots and final restore. Reconcile the stateless declaration. Do not merely remove the assertions: scratch_native_state restores original buffers after each forward, so permitting buffers alone does not implement a chosen persistent BN policy.
findings.title: The pinned native IMDB body has BatchNorm buffers and is rejected by every constructor

findings.evidence: The role gate checks token.role, but the following ids override is accepted without checking membership or completeness against self.rows[token.role]. A TRAIN token with ids set to VALID or unassigned rows passes that gate; output validation only checks len(ids).
findings.impact: The exported forward API does not enforce its Unknown/TEST role access refused contract and can produce ablated VALID or unknown outputs under a TRAIN label. The internal train_epoch separately validates its batch, and evaluate uses canonical rows, so no leakage in those shipped flows is established by this finding.
findings.required_action: Validate explicit IDs as exactly the complete canonical role rows or their permitted permutation, including uniqueness and length. Keep ablated VALID diagnostics on their explicitly allowed diagnostic path.
findings.title: Explicit IDs can bypass the forward role restriction
